title: Tasks are categorised and carry their origin (S16)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S16 (Sector 5 — Tasks (ADR 0018)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0018 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: `kind`, `area`, `stack`, `from` in `krn.task/v1`; create requires kind and area; task-quality becomes one check inside src/task
Files: see ADR 0018 Consequences.
Proof: `bin/krn task check: pass` and `bin/krn task list --kind gate --json: ok`
Predicted: metric new-tasks-with-kind-share >= 0.8
After: S12
